findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "start_streaming_transcription" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: synthesize_speech, start_streaming_transcription · Private data: list_dialects, list_voices, get_plan, synthesize_speech, transcribe_audio · Public sink: synthesize_speech, transcribe_audio, start_streaming_transcription · Destructive: synthesize_speech.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: synthesize_speech, start_streaming_transcription · Private data: list_dialects, list_voices, get_plan, synthesize_speech, transcribe_audio · Public sink: synthesize_speech, transcribe_audio, start_streaming_transcription · Destructive: synthesize_speech

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
